name: prompt-1093
image_vibe: Sunlit retro cafe, Fujifilm NC-inspired color, dreamy overexposure, heavy analog grain
image_purpose: Create a nostalgic cafe portrait with playful retro styling and candid film texture.

prompt.project_info: An analog 35mm portrait in a sunlight-drenched retro cafe.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult Japanese woman with dark hair in twin braids tied with ribbons. She wears a gray cardigan worn securely over a fully opaque white polka-dot dress and chunky black Mary Jane shoes. She sits sideways on a wooden chair and looks back toward the camera with a warm, shy smile.
prompt.composition_elements: Sideways seated pose with crossed legs, visible Mary Jane shoes, wooden chair, retro cafe interior, and candid three-quarter portrait framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large-window sunlight with significant dreamy overexposure, blown-out highlights, washed pastel tones, light leaks, and nostalgic high-noise film texture.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm analog film, Fujifilm NC-inspired simulation, heavy grain, candid portrait, natural motion, soft focus, realistic fabric and skin texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a candid 35mm film portrait of an original adult Japanese woman in a sunlight-drenched retro cafe. Give her dark twin braids with ribbons, a securely worn gray cardigan over a fully opaque white polka-dot dress, and chunky black Mary Jane shoes. Seat her sideways on a wooden chair with crossed legs as she looks back at camera with a warm shy smile. Use Fujifilm NC-inspired colors, large-window overexposure, washed pastel tones, light leaks, soft focus, and heavy nostalgic film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, opened clothing, exposed underwear, nudity, seductive posing, transparent dress, plastic skin, digital oversharpening, distorted anatomy, watermark, text
